Je m’appelle Laëtitia Lima et j’ai chois: My name is Laëtitia Lima, and I chose to build my own brand before shaping anyone else's.
Depuis toujours, je suis attirée par l’u: Marketing has always drawn me in, as much for its visual power as for its strategic depth. Yet nothing predestined me for this path. After secondary school I started from scratch, with no technical background, but one clear ambition: to learn, to build structure, and to move towards the field that had fascinated me since my early teens.
I built that path step by step. I learned to identify my strengths, develop my vision and assert my professional stance. Before even thinking about the brands I would one day support, I worked on my own: my values, my positioning and my way of telling a story.
Aujourd’hui, après l’obtention de mon Ti: Today, having earned my Level 6 RNCP qualification as a Digital Project Manager along with my degree in Communication and Digital Marketing, I am starting a Master's at ESP in Brand Strategy and Brand Content. A logical next step, aligned with my ambition.

EMOI est un projet de conception d’une b: EMOI is the design of an innovative interactive kiosk allowing anyone to create their own bespoke fragrance from neuroscientific and sensory cues. Conceived as an immersive experience, the project combines technology, emotion and personalisation to offer a unique user journey, where scent choices are guided by the user's emotions and feelings. The project was selected to represent the campus at the national Ydays competition.
EMOI repose sur l’idée que le parfum ne: EMOI rests on the idea that a fragrance should not be chosen, but revealed. The project draws on a neuroscientific approach to turn what is often an intuitive decision into an immersive experience. Through two distinct entry points, users are invited to explore their emotions or their sensory preferences to arrive at a creation that genuinely reflects them.
Conception du parcours utilisateur, inté: Designing the user journey around two neuroscientific entry points. Producing the interface mockups, with a focus on immersion, a seamless journey and the user's emotional engagement.
Création complète de l’identité de marqu: Building the complete EMOI brand identity, including naming, positioning and visual world. Designing the logo, the kiosk mockup, the presentation materials and the communication visuals.
Pilotage global du projet EMOI, de la ph: Leading the EMOI project end to end, from ideation to preparing the final competition pitch. Coordinating the team, allocating tasks, meeting deadlines, structuring deliverables and overseeing the overall coherence of the concept.
Ce projet scolaire intitulé « Notre Ever: This academic project, titled “Our own Everest”, is an awareness campaign created for AIDES, France's leading association fighting HIV and viral hepatitis. The aim was to design communication that was both powerful and accessible, raising public awareness of prevention through a human and committed approach.
La métaphore de l’Everest, symbole du pa: The Everest metaphor stands for the journey of people living with HIV. That climb, often seen as insurmountable, becomes possible with the right support. Through this metaphor, the campaign highlights strength, resilience and hope, while underlining the importance of solidarity, collective support and associations.
Construction d’un storytelling visuel pu: Building a powerful visual narrative around the Everest metaphor for the journey of people living with HIV, through mountain imagery, staged progression (Camp 1 to Camp 6) and the red ribbon as the central element.
Déploiement d’une stratégie de communica: Rolling out a 360 communication strategy built on several levers to reach the audience at different moments and places. The campaign combines urban display (bus shelters, metro, tram, shopping centres), digital activation on social media (Instagram and X) and street marketing.
Conception et déclinaison d’un ensemble: Designing and adapting a coherent, high-impact set of materials. These include large-format posters for urban spaces, digital content for Instagram (posts, interactive stories, reels) and X (interactive tweets), along with event and street-marketing devices such as “Everest” phone booths and clean tags in the city.
Joe’s Pizza est un projet de refonte d’i: Joe’s Pizza is a visual identity redesign aimed at modernising the image of an iconic New York pizzeria while preserving its authenticity and Italian heritage. The goal was to strengthen the brand's graphic coherence, set it apart from competitors and adapt its identity to the digital era while respecting its vintage, popular DNA.
Nouveau logo intégrant trois éléments st: A new logo built on three defining elements: the vintage mascot, the iconic slice and the Italian tricolour. A brand book covering logo variations, the colour palette and the typographic choices.

Les Nuits Élégantes est un projet événem:
Les Nuits Élégantes is an event project created during a 72-hour challenge, with the goal of building a high-end private club for affluent professionals. As a team, we had to imagine an exclusive experience capable of attracting an influential clientele, combining brand strategy, premium events and a viable business model.

The project won the 72-hour challenge, rewarding its strategic coherence, the quality of the world created and the strength of the business model presented.
Une soirée immersive à l’Intercontinenta: An immersive evening at the Intercontinental in Bordeaux for 150 guests, with a precise running order: a live orchestra, a jazz singer, a burlesque show to close and a seven-course tasting menu inspired by 1920s cinema. Identifying the material and staffing needs, and anticipating risks.
Univers visuel noir et doré inspiré de l: A black-and-gold visual world inspired by the aesthetics of 1880 to 1920. Creating the premium materials, including the exclusive membership card, staff pins and the mockup of a secure private website accessible by login.
Ciblée exclusivement sur les CSP++, en c: Targeted exclusively at affluent professionals, combining high-end invitations, a private platform, selective LinkedIn and WhatsApp groups and a referral system. Defining SMART objectives, KPIs and a detailed budget.
Infusions Astrales est un projet de déve:
Infusions Astrales is a product range project created for the Provence d’Antan brand. The aim was to design a new collection of infusions based on astrology, combining market analysis, visual creation and a complete marketing strategy.

The ambition was to modernise the image of herbal tea by making it more personalised, more beautiful and connected to current wellness and astrology trends.
Étude du marché des tisanes astrologique: Studying the astrological herbal tea market and the steadily growing astrology market overall, identifying opportunities around personalisation, organic products and digitalisation. A competitive analysis positioned the range. Defining the target audiences, retail pricing and a go-to-market strategy.
L’association entre chaque signe astrolo: Pairing each astrological sign with a specific flavour. Every infusion is designed to reflect the character traits of its sign, with a strong and recognisable visual identity. The originality of the concept lies in personifying the signs through feminine visuals generated from their symbolic characteristics, to create an immediate emotional attachment.
Univers graphique complet de la gamme :: A complete graphic world for the range: moodboard, typography, palettes differentiated by sign, custom visuals, technical templates and realistic mockups. Each sign has unique packaging with its dedicated flavour, an astrological card and graphic consistency. Gift sets grouped by elemental family.
Stratégie de communication incluant un p: A communication strategy including an editorial calendar, content and a distinctive digital concept built around “Astronalisation”. Proposed influencer collaborations, partnerships with spas, tea rooms and events, plus a detailed production and media activation budget.
Un benchmark détaillé, en analysant leur: A detailed benchmark analysing their communication, sales channels, graphic codes and digital presence. Defining a positioning built on authenticity, heritage and visual clarity.
Le concept repose sur l’équilibre entre:
The concept balances three strong pillars: the brand's vintage heritage, the modernity its evolution demands, and the Italian identity at the origin of pizza. We chose to keep certain historic codes, notably the mascot, while simplifying and modernising the graphic composition. The identity revisits the Italian colours, adopts clearer and more consistent typography, and strengthens the pizza slice as the central symbol of the logo.
                                The aim was to create a timeless identity capable of evoking nostalgia, authenticity and warmth.
Le concept repose sur une soirée immersi:
The concept centres on an immersive evening titled Éclat d’Hollywood, inspired by the years 1880 to 1920. The ambition was to recreate the glamour of cinema's golden age through a complete stage design blending black-and-gold decor, red carpet, feathers, live orchestra, jazz singer and burlesque show.

Beyond the evening itself, we imagined a full private-club ecosystem built on exclusivity, invitation-only access, referrals and a secure online platform.

Dans le cadre du projet fil rouge Reboot: As part of the Reboot Museum capstone project, our team carried out the full digital repositioning of the Bordeaux Museum of Fine Arts (MusBA). Faced with falling attendance among 18-35 year-olds and an institutional image seen as unengaging, the school commissioned us to rethink its digital presence, brand identity and user experience. Run over a full year (October 2025 to June 2026, 196 hours), the project drew on three RNCP skill blocks: strategic analysis and scoping, project management, and digital marketing strategy.
Une stratégie digitale complète pour rec: A complete digital strategy to win back young audiences at the Bordeaux Museum of Fine Arts, built around the immersive concept “Journey Through Time”, blending virtual reality, artificial intelligence and an escape game.
« Cet été, soyez sauveteur. Pas spectate: “This summer, be a lifeguard. Not a bystander.” rests on a projection mechanism: turning a simple mental image into action. Built around the participatory hashtag #TrouveTonPlanDEau, the campaign connects young candidates with the coastal areas where they are genuinely needed, inviting them to picture themselves as lifeguards in real towns. Positioning: accessible, useful and rewarding.
Définition de trois cibles et de leurs r: Definition of three audiences and their roles: 16-25 year-olds (spark the calling), parents as prescribers (remove the barriers), general public (create the sense of urgency). Three detailed personas and a two-phase geographic plan (Bordeaux/Poitiers as student pools, La Rochelle/Bayonne as high-risk areas).
Une campagne nationale conçue en 48 heur: A national campaign designed in 48 hours to recruit qualified lifeguards (BNSSA), built on a strong causal chain: fewer trained lifeguards means more drownings. This is not a recruitment campaign. It is a campaign that saves lives.
Planning social media multi-plateformes: Multi-platform social media schedule (TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn) over 8 months: launch and adoption (April-May), mass engagement and virality (June-August), reassurance (September-October), conversion and sign-up (November). Total budget: €9,610 (outdoor advertising €3,830 + social media €5,780).
Analyse PESTEL, 5 forces de Porter, SWOT: PESTEL analysis, Porter’s five forces, SWOT and positioning map within the Bordeaux cultural ecosystem. Drafting of the functional and technical specifications, the project schedule, risk management and a budget estimated at €58,642 excl. VAT.
« Voyage dans le Temps » positionne le M: “Journey Through Time” positions MusBA as a living, experiential venue connected to contemporary cultural habits. The concept is built around immersive features combining virtual reality, artificial intelligence and an escape game, in order to create a strong, memorable and shareable cultural experience; driven by technology and tuned to the codes of the 18-35 generation.
Affiche de campagne « Cet été je serai s: Campaign poster “This summer I will be a lifeguard”
5 livrables prêts à l’emploi : panneaux: Five ready-to-use deliverables: outdoor advertising panels across 4 cities, TikTok and Instagram content, LinkedIn posts, Instagram carousels, newsletter. Target KPIs: 2 million+ impressions, engagement ≥ 6%, 50,000+ clicks, 5,000 BNSSA sign-ups.
Dans le cadre du Challenge 48h Ynov, not: As part of the Ynov 48-hour Challenge, our team designed a 360° campaign to recruit qualified lifeguards (BNSSA) in response to 400 drownings a year in France. The diagnosis revealed a direct causal chain: fewer trained lifeguards means fewer lifeguard stations open, therefore less supervision and more drownings. That finding changed the very nature of the campaign: this is not simply a recruitment campaign, it is a campaign that saves lives by recruiting.
